proxy_note: Head/bite-focused Kusaregedo selection for The Mouth form (owner 2026-10-19): headbutt, head projectile, tongue, bone AA + clumsy heavies.
canon_note: Second demon form. Head overgrows body: slow, topples over, too heavy, clumsy. Weak normals, devastating head/bite attacks.

head-slam.name: Head Slam
head-slam.note: Overhead slam with the overgrown head.

tongue-sweep.name: Tongue Sweep
tongue-sweep.note: Long low-hitting tongue sweep. Unsafe on block.

bone-uppercut.name: Bone Uppercut
bone-uppercut.note: Swings arm-bone diagonally upward. Hitbox follows the arc. Anti-air.

spine-attack.name: Spine Attack
spine-attack.note: Attacks with his own spine. Faster AA that hits crouchers.

ground-slap.name: Ground Slap
ground-slap.note: Big slap to ground. Strong counter-poke.

quick-palm.name: Quick Palm
quick-palm.note: Quick palm. Tick-throw setup into command grab.

clumsy-stumble.name: Clumsy Stumble
clumsy-stumble.note: Head overgrows body: topples forward into a crushing fall. Slow, clumsy, devastating.
